entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 provides a universal memory layer for AI agents, with separate memory states for users, sessions, and agents. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as an OSS SDK, a self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight supports long-term agent memory through retain, recall, and reflect operations. It offers Python, Node.js/TypeScript, and Go clients, and works with multiple LLM providers, including local options.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent knowledge, memories, and skills in one filesystem, with L0 abstracts, L1 overviews, and L2 details. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider that uses viking:// URIs; sessions can be archived and memories extracted as Markdown.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee builds connected memory from documents, code, and conversations, and can process text locally without an LLM. Its CLI lets agents remember and recall text.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory extracts facts from conversations and handles contradictions through a single API for memory, RAG, and connectors. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider and also offers plugins for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other tools.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain stores sourced facts and supports correcting or withdrawing them. It connects to existing agents and shares memory across agents, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho stores messages and events on sessions, then reasons in the background to update peer representations. It is available as a managed service, local CLI, or self-hosted FastAPI server, and is the upstream library used by the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats context as a plain Markdown tree and provides Git-like commit, branch, and merge operations for managing it. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider, with a React/Ink TUI and REPL, five retrieval tiers, and support for 20 LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes Agents, with one pure-Python dependency. It integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK; BEAM results are reported for v3.0.0, while LongMemEval is pending.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto consolidates memories and reconciles conflicting information, then briefs agents with relevant memories before they act. It also supports importing and exporting through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS combines vector search and structured facts in a seven-layer memory system, with an auto-curated wiki. Its local infrastructure uses Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and its Ground Truth hierarchy prioritizes injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext runs agent tasks against evaluations, keeps useful lessons, and discards dead ends. It leaves traces, reports, and playbooks to support work on complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Hermes Agent plugin uses a SQLite store and hierarchical DAG to persist messages, with the goal of never losing a message. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from prior context.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: Deja-vu searches session histories from 41 coding agents, making past sessions available for recall. Recall can appear at session start or after command failures, and sessions can be synced between machines with SSH.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project lets Hermes Agent use Honcho for private, cross-session memory on a self-hosted setup. It supports OpenAI-compatible LLM providers and local inference servers, with an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer that can be used across multiple agent harnesses. It imports files, webpages, and agent conversations, and includes a dashboard for browsing memories and their sources.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur stores shared agent memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk, with local search after a one-time model download and a keyword fallback. Its README reports 95.6% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (N=500).
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25 and vector search with rank fusion and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, with integrations through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system with a SQLite-backed, five-tier hierarchical schema and FTS5 search. Its five-package family includes an SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and LangGraph BaseStore, without a vector database or embedding model.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for cache sharing, including text and multimodal context. It provides a context index for reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling, and integrates with Hermes Agent, vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, and OpenClaw.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This Hermes memory plugin uses an in-process backend by default, so no separate server is required. Its recall results include a why_retrieved reason, and it supports canonicalization and contradiction tracking.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This agent-driven memory CLI maintains a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history across sessions. It is designed to proactively recall, maintain, and evolve knowledge without embeddings or a vector database.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn stores durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter, using an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. It uses a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and retrieval, and connects to coding agents through MCP servers and host-specific plugins.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd watches agent session logs to prefetch context in an anticipatory cache. It uses local SQLite-vec storage and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, with an MCP-native server and automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack brings Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace together under one memory owner for Hermes. It manages state and retrieval with SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma, then gives the agent a purpose-built evidence packet for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep combines semantic search, BM25 full-text search, and ranked graph traversal to help agents find relevant stored information. It can index codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR, while edge tags link notes through navigable, bidirectional relationships.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema tokens by ranking tools locally with keywords, and supports Tool Search. It integrates through middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19 or later, with a dashboard for tracking savings and managing configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides Git-backed context and workflows in plain Markdown for Claude Code, Codex, and compatible coding agents. Its first-class adapters and reviewed handoffs, which use hash-checked proposals and receipts, distinguish it as a workflow-oriented context layer.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This plugin keeps memory local in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and uses importance-weighted recall to surface higher-priority memories during context prefetch. It supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships between entries.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources, then registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports. It also registers pre-LLM-call and session-end and session-finalize hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes AgentMemory uses an on-demand summarizer for pull-model episodic memory and supports immediate event deletion, without persistent summaries. Its trace.jsonl file records an audit trace of prefetch operations.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind recovers the original goal from the first user turn of a long Claude Code or Codex session, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and does not use a summarizing model or external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: The XMemo plugin provides durable cross-session memory for Hermes with semantic search and native hooks for pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots. A local SQLite layer supports caching and write-outbox reliability, and the plugin can read memories from other connected agents.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools to search and manually store memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, including semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A. Its slash commands cover search, file reads, context, and Q&A, and it supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop alongside repo sync and indexed git-history search commands.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. Its retrieval options include HNSW approximate nearest-neighbor search, sparse search, and FM-index retrieval, and it can run through native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides Hermes Agent memory tools, including 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It combines BM25, vector, and graph methods for hybrid search, and can checkpoint context during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit focuses on memory curation rather than database-backed storage: it works with Markdown files and produces JSON diffs for review. Its rot and lint curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository lets you track and revert changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers pairs composable skills with instructions that guide agents through a software development workflow from specification and design sign-off to planning and subagent execution. Its documented support for multiple harnesses makes it a fit for teams that want a structured development methodology across agent setups.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first system for design and prototyping, with skills, templates, design systems, and plugins. It supports several coding agents, including Hermes Agent, and also offers a native DeepSeek Harness runtime.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides a structured cybersecurity skills collection spanning 34 security domains. Its skills are mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3, and the project lists compatibility with more than 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable draw.io files. Its incremental sync is designed to preserve manual layout and annotations, and diagrams can be generated through the diagramctl CLI or an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet Court provides a master router and connector skills for agent-to-agent commerce, alongside vendored copies of official protocol skills. It adds a verification and dispute-resolution layer to the skills it brings together.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid AI Writing can detect writing patterns, rewrite text, or edit prose in place, with optional casual, professional, technical, warm, and blunt profiles. Its command-line detector accepts files or piped text, making it useful for both one-off checks and text-processing workflows.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw uses background evolution to deduplicate and improve skills, and can unify skill libraries across agents, devices, and team members. It integrates with Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform skills library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills, with compatibility for Claude Code, Codex, and agent skills specifications. It also maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers professional agent skills as plain Markdown files, with listed tasks ranging from writing PRDs to decoding leases. An installer copies the skill files, and uninstalling removes them; the README says they run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: These skills cover YouTube transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction, with support for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor. Use requires a TranscriptAPI key, which offers a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes Skill Factory watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills, then generates SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds. Slash commands let users manage, list, and save the detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super Hermes teaches Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks, with pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, including remote skill registries from Git and S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and scripts, with sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, while a review gate evaluates specs with PASS/FAIL models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Creates .lit.md documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code, then extracts runnable files with a tangler. It also syncs edits to source files back into the literate document, keeping code and documentation connected.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running agents, with SQLite storage and event logging through a mechanism kernel. It also coordinates agent teams through the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes and skills.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Shares memory across instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: A Portuguese-language Hermes Agent community project offering skills in SKILL.md format alongside installation, configuration, and usage guides. Contributions are made through forks and pull requests.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides prompting guidance for FLUX image and video generation, plus BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. Its FLUX 3 video suite includes eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills that follow the Agent Skills spec, with installation available through npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills. The README describes the repository as containing community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agent instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse, with both automated and step-by-step workflows. It also includes skill testing and export.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a workflow language for AI that checks workflows before calling a model and runs with a model of your choice. It also verifies a tamper-evident record for each run.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Offers a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with a Python client and CLI. Skills can be installed with recursive dependency resolution, and the project includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in rollback procedures provide a way to recover safely.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This Hermes Agent skill manages Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for validating credentials and configuring access.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub is a community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills, with federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification and is described as operating autonomously around the clock via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye narrows the skills presented before LLM calls using a five-layer retrieval system that includes hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It is designed to reduce token usage and can degrade gracefully when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is an ADHD-friendly personal execution system for habits, study blocks, and agent control through MCP. It stores data locally in a single SQLite file and includes a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs read-only, adversarial code reviews using parallel subagents focused on edge cases, adversarial review, and integration analysis. It combines a deterministic pre-scan with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings; it identifies problems but does not fix them.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This Hermes Agent skill coordinates Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents to simplify code, supporting TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust. Its tiered application process includes an approval gate, distinguishing it from a fully automatic rewrite.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize for Hermes adapts verified procedures for breaking tasks into multiple stories with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It also provides an investigation protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, plus a Python goal engine for persistent task state.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: Hermes Cybersec Lab packages cybersecurity skills and tools, with highlights citing 2,077 total skills across repositories, 131+ tools for network, forensics, and exploitation, and 28 frameworks and standards. Its listed integrations include MITRE ATT&CK, MISP, CVSS, EPSS, OWASP, NIST, Sigma, and YARA.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: Skillsdotnet is a C#/.NET implementation of agentskills.io with MCP integration. It uses SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure, integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading, and can automatically register common agent skill directories.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides plain-markdown skills for code review, session management, and related workflows, and is described as production-tested across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode. Skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is a local, read-only dashboard for real-time visibility into Hermes Agent activity, including token costs, session history, skill analytics, and incidents. It belongs in a skills list as an observability companion, with optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill creates reproducible demo GIFs for a repository README using vhs or Playwright recording scripts, then optimizes them for target sizes under 8 MB. It supports demos of terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server searches remoteopenclaw.com for more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, and provides installation commands for discovered tools and plugins. It is useful for Hermes users looking to find and install capabilities through an MCP-compatible client.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: Agent Skill Builder generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes. It also checks official frontmatter specifications weekly for field changes, helping skills stay aligned with their specifications.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: Skill Evolution analyzes agent session history to identify skill coverage gaps and draft structured improvement proposals. It gates updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators, and runs locally using Python’s standard library without daemons or external services.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These Hermes Agent skills route file operations using the path syntax for native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, or WSL, and select and verify existing project-compatible Python interpreters. They address two practical tasks when using Hermes across Windows environments.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides agent skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment, with support for Claude Code, Cursor, and other agentskills.io-compliant clients. It also includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection of Hermes skills covers Douyin video transcription into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, Chinese AI-writing cleanup with a rule-based engine, and structured data extraction from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. Its focus is a set of concrete media and document-processing tasks.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This Hermes Agent plugin lets agents find support bounties, purchase ticket context, and submit answers for human review, with public wallet earnings records. It also lets users create a bounty board that returns a URL, API key, and USDC deposit addresses.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses and supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers, then issues certificates verifiable with Ed25519 signatures. Its public API supports certificate verification and skill submission.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server, exposing 191 tools and five ready-to-use workflow skills. The project also lists support for Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This Hermes Agent skill generates structured Chinese news briefings at scales ranging from global to street level, with core conclusions and suggested actions. It uses semantic memory to incorporate user interests into search expansion, helping tailor each briefing.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This MCP server provides deterministic Western and Vedic astrology results for AI agents, with SHA-256 hashes for verification. It offers a no-auth MCP endpoint and per-call REST payments through x402 or MPP.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: Agentic-MCP-Skill is a progressive MCP client that incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas through three-layer lazy loading to minimize token usage. Its socket-based daemon maintains persistent connections, making it a distinct fit for Hermes Agent skills that need to manage MCP discovery efficiently.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents applies a multi-agent framework to financial trading: fundamental analysts assess company financials and performance metrics, while sentiment analysts aggregate news headlines, StockTwits, and Reddit chatter. Selected analysts work in parallel using their own tools, bringing different kinds of analysis to the trading process.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides a self-hosted interface for governing agent registration, task dispatch, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It supports multi-agent workflows through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires is a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and other named agent tools. It keeps sessions running in the background with tmux and offers sandboxing plus dashboards with diff review.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This Control Room-first template describes a path from a single Hermes Agent on one VPS to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture uses a task bus for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation and handoffs, and includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: SwarmClaw is for building autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts show how agent teams are delegated, setting it apart as a swarm-oriented option.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions offers a single-screen mission control for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. Its Kanban board tracks task status and review queues, while live streams show agent reasoning and tool execution; proposed task completions require human verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A strict pipeline architecture and Master Orchestrator handle routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for collaboration between Leader and Specialist agents, managing an automated task lifecycle. It uses MCP and ACP for local tool and communication handling, with a real-time web UI for agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It runs TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations and provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator stages two competing AI companies, orchestrating nine autonomous agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning. A real-time dashboard displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel implements a local Mixture-of-Agents stack by querying models in parallel and synthesizing their outputs, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, with stated optimization for RTX 4080/5080 hardware and no cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a full project knowledge graph with `codegraph init`, using structural extraction and cross-file resolution across supported languages. Its MCP support for multiple coding agents makes pre-indexed code context available to Hermes Agent and other agents while reducing token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale tracks token usage and costs across Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, and other AI coding agents by reading each client’s local storage. It also offers a command to submit usage to a leaderboard and public profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap records coding-agent API traffic for local inspection, with support for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor CLI, and others. It exports trace sessions to a self-contained HTML viewer and redacts common authentication headers before recording.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor displays token usage, costs, rate limits, and session details for Hermes Agent and other listed CLIs, reading their local data paths. It adds multi-device sync and historical usage trends for monitoring activity over time.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers, and also works with AI providers that support markdown or general prompting. Its integrations include Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot, making it a design-focused tool in this developer-tools list.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes adds an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes skills for product briefs, design handoffs, and implementation, plus seven agents spanning product lifecycle roles and GitHub integration for issue and pull request delivery.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins is a community CLI for customizing the Hermes terminal UI, including banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. YAML-based configuration lets users create themes, with examples ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk styles.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a command-line static linter for AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts, using HERM v1.1 scoring. It scans prompts, tool definitions, schemas, and agent files, then reports findings with specific fixes and supported line references.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place describes itself as a social economy for autonomous AI agents, with encrypted agent-to-agent messaging using Signal Protocol and identity registration through human-readable @handles. It also supports commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through MCP, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and other AI providers. Its supervisor sidebar manages agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads, alongside support for external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, running natively in Claude Code without a separate process or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages with two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin automatically captures and recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating with preconfigured CLI workflows, with the project reporting 90–99% token savings. It also bundles 40+ skills for finance, DevOps, and research and provides automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents with folder-specific configuration, skills, memories, tools, and instructions. It switches between the default agent and a scoped agent, making it suited to workflows that need project-local behavior.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: evey-setup automates installation of Hermes Agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This tool migrates OpenClaw data—including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives—to Hermes. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: observeco monitors AI agents through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time conversation telemetry. Its two monitoring modes include zero-token passive analysis and scheduled active probing, while config-aware baselines track performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: hermes-voice adds voice interaction to Hermes Agent, with wake-word support, adaptive turn-taking, and barge-in. It runs offline without API keys or accounts and supports 35 languages via Piper and nine via Kokoro.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: hermes-startup is a local runtime for pursuing online opportunities, operating in deterministic zero-network mode by default. It requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes, and includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: hermes-memoss is a MemOS memory plugin that supports semantic search and multidimensional memory storage. It provides tools to search, add, and delete memories, and includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC-Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent CLIs, including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place, with versions for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local, open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs. Its built-in agent offers file access, web search, and image generation, while 21 ready-to-use professional assistants and support for macOS, Windows, and Linux make it a broader workspace option.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI provides browser-based access to Hermes Agent, including from a phone, without a build step or framework. Its three-panel layout combines chat with a workspace file browser, and the project documents access through an SSH tunnel.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a desktop companion for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools, and the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a Hermes Agent web dashboard for chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and channel configuration. It also offers shared and group chats, visual workflows, persistent sessions, and tools for files, voice, devices, and agent management; it is available as a desktop app, npm package, or Docker image.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace brings chat, a terminal, a memory browser, a skills manager, and an inspector into a native web workspace. Its Swarm Mode supports role-based dispatch with tmux-backed workers, alongside an MCP catalog and a file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: CodeG is a collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, as a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, then delegate tasks with @ or queue them in separate worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This Hermes desktop workspace connects directly to local or SSH-hosted Hermes systems, with native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs. Its embedded terminal provides direct shell access for tasks such as system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first Chinese desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS. It includes a Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health checks and updates, plus interfaces for chat, memory management, and LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to a local, Cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtime. Its Bot Mode supports agent switching and group chats; the project notes that Firefox omits Chromium-only real-tab attachment.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone client for driving a self-hosted Hermes Agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It requires you to run the server, supports iOS 18 and later, and is described as free with no analytics or tracking.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. Its runtime dashboard tracks token usage and latency, while a live workspace shows code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for monitoring Hermes. It tracks agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs, and adds a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and cockpit for Hermes sessions and sessions from other coding-agent CLIs. It lets users search prompts, responses, tool activity, errors, and supported image references, resume supported sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp, and view Codex and Claude quota burn per session.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted web dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, bringing browser-based tools and agent status into one place. Its highlights include streaming chat with tool-call visualization, an MCP server control plane, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for running Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects a local Hermes agent to web dashboards through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox lets users review requests with side effects before they proceed.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing agent sessions. It also combines a kanban board for agentic work with controls for profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a locally run, mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. Its features include streaming terminal chat with file attachments, Telegram validation using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication, and background spawning for up to five agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent packages Hermes as a Windows desktop app with a GUI and 100 tools across more than 20 toolsets. It supports cloud AI and LM Studio local models, and includes a workflow engine for scheduling, conditions, loops, and parallel execution.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a self-hosted AI assistant interface with a glassmorphic design, chat, and real-time log streaming. It also provides a file browser, task tracking dashboard, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a dashboard for monitoring and configuring Hermes, with real-time session activity and cost tracking. Users can inspect conversation histories and skill source code, while configuration and environment variables are available for read-only monitoring.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan UI is a self-hosted AI workspace centered on chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It also includes a marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a multi-agent desktop client with streaming chat, model switching, and collaboration among 20 specialized AI agents. Its visual Skill Store offers more than 50 curated one-click installations, alongside a PM orchestrator.
